title: S26 Ultra colours: all six shades and the two exclusives
description: The six Galaxy S26 Ultra colours, the two sold only by Samsung, what Samsung Vietnam and FPT Shop list, and how to check the colours on sale in your country.
h1: Galaxy S26 Ultra colours: the six official shades, the two Samsung exclusives and what Vietnam sells
intro: Samsung lists six colours for the Galaxy S26 Ultra as of November 2026: Cobalt Violet, Sky Blue, Black and White as standard, plus Pink Gold and Silver Shadow as Samsung.com exclusives. In Vietnam, Samsung sells the two exclusive colours only on samsung.com/vn and at Samsung West Lake and Samsung 68. The phone went on sale on 11 March 2026. Many articles from January 2026 use other colour names, which came from leaks before launch.
keyPoints: The Galaxy S26 Ultra has **six official colours**: Cobalt Violet, Sky Blue, Black, White, Pink Gold and Silver Shadow (Samsung newsroom, 27 February 2026).
**Pink Gold and Silver Shadow are Samsung's own exclusives.** In Vietnam the buy page names only Samsung.com, Samsung West Lake and Samsung 68 as sellers, checked 24 November 2026.
Samsung Vietnam's colour names are **Tím Cobalt, Xanh Sky Blue, Đen Classic, Trắng Classic, Vàng Hồng and Bạc Shadow**.
FPT Shop's S26 Ultra page listed only the four standard colours on 24 November 2026.
Black Shadow, White Shadow, Galactical Blue and Ultraviolet were **names from leaks** before launch. Samsung did not use them.
Samsung's own footnote says colour availability **may vary by country or carrier**, so check your country's Samsung buy page before you choose.

sections.title: What colours does the Galaxy S26 Ultra come in?

blocks.text: The Galaxy S26 Ultra comes in six colours. Four are standard: **Cobalt Violet, Sky Blue, Black and White**. Two are exclusive to Samsung: **Pink Gold and Silver Shadow**. Samsung Electronics makes and sells the phone. It announced the Galaxy S26 series at Galaxy Unpacked in San Francisco on 25 February 2026.

Samsung's UK newsroom wrote on 27 February 2026 that the S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra share a unified design language and the same colour options. It also gave the dates: pre-orders opened on 25 February and the Ultra went on sale on 11 March 2026. Samsung Vietnam's newsroom also gives 11 March as the start of sales through carriers, retailers and Samsung.com.

blocks.title: Colours vary by country
blocks.text: Samsung Singapore's spec page lists all six colours. Its footnote says: "Colour availability may vary depending on country or carrier." Some countries or carriers may sell only some of the six, so the list for your country is the one that counts.

sections.title: Which S26 Ultra colours are Samsung exclusives?

blocks.text: Pink Gold and Silver Shadow are the two exclusive colours. Samsung sells them through its own channels only, not through other shops or most carriers. Samsung's UK newsroom calls them "the Samsung.com exclusive colours". Samsung Vietnam's buy page calls them Special Editions.
Where can I buy the exclusive colours in Vietnam?

In Vietnam you can buy Pink Gold (Vàng Hồng) and Silver Shadow (Bạc Shadow) only from Samsung's own outlets. On 24 November 2026, [Samsung Vietnam's buy page](https://www.samsung.com/vn/smartphones/galaxy-s26-ultra/buy/) said the exclusive colours are "Chỉ có tại Samsung.com, Samsung West Lake, Samsung 68" (only at Samsung.com, Samsung West Lake and Samsung 68). The page lists them under "Màu độc quyền" (exclusive colours), so in Vietnam they are Samsung exclusives rather than online-only: two physical Samsung stores sell them as well. Ask the store directly about stock and opening hours before you go.
Does "online exclusive" mean the same thing in every country?

No. The list of outlets differs from country to country. On 24 November 2026, [Samsung US's buy page](https://www.samsung.com/us/smartphones/galaxy-s26-ultra/buy/) said "Only available at Samsung.com and Samsung Experience Stores", so in the US Samsung's own shops sell them too. Vietnam names its own outlets, listed above. Other countries may name different ones.
Can I buy Pink Gold or Silver Shadow at FPT Shop?

FPT Shop did not list them on 24 November 2026. [Its S26 Ultra page](https://fptshop.com.vn/dien-thoai/samsung-galaxy-s26-ultra) showed purple, blue, black and white, with the full names Tím Cobalt, Xanh Sky Blue, Đen Classic and Trắng Classic in the spec table. If another shop advertises an exclusive colour, ask where the phone came from and check it before you pay.

sections.title: Where to buy each S26 Ultra colour in Vietnam

blocks.text: Samsung.com/vn sells all six colours. FPT Shop sells only the four standard colours. Samsung's own page also offers more storage sizes than FPT Shop showed on 24 November 2026.

blocks.text: Is every colour available in every storage size?

Samsung's page did not say. On 24 November 2026 it showed "Bộ sản phẩm không khả dụng" (product set unavailable) on some menu options without saying which colour or storage size was affected. Choose your colour, then each storage size, and confirm the exact combination appears as in stock before you pay.

blocks.title: Order limits on Samsung's page
blocks.text: On 24 November 2026 Samsung Vietnam's S26 Ultra page showed "Sản phẩm có sẵn" (in stock) next to "Đã đạt số lượng đặt hàng tối đa cho sản phẩm này" (maximum order quantity reached for this product). If you need more than one phone, or the message stops you checking out, contact Samsung Vietnam's customer service before you try another seller.
Does the colour change the price?

FPT Shop's page says each storage size costs the same in all four of its colours. We did not confirm whether Samsung charges more for the Special Edition colours. Select each colour on Samsung's page and compare the total at checkout. FPT Shop's page also gave two different prices for the 256 GB model on 24 November 2026, so treat the price shown at checkout as the real one. For where to buy a phone in Vietnam in general, and the 4G rules, see [buying a phone in Vietnam](/guides/buy-phone-in-vietnam).

People also sell phones, used ones included, in the [electronics category](/c/electronics) on eno.vn, a classifieds marketplace for expats and locals in Vietnam. Check a used phone's colour, storage and condition in person before you pay.

sections.title: Why do older articles list different S26 Ultra colours?

blocks.text: Articles from before launch used colour names from leaks, and Samsung did not adopt them. In January 2026, VietNamNet (20 January) and Viettel Store (21 January) reported four colours called Black Shadow, White Shadow, Galactical Blue and Ultraviolet. Both based this on leaked SIM-tray parts. Viettel Store's headline calls the colours official, but its own text says the phone was only "expected" to come in them.

The leaks got the four colour families right: black, white, blue and purple. They got the names wrong. Samsung launched the colours as Black, White, Sky Blue and Cobalt Violet, and added two exclusive colours the leaks did not mention.

blocks.caption: Colour names from leaks (January 2026 reports) and the closest official Samsung colour (Samsung newsroom, 27 February 2026). The pairing is by colour family only.

blocks.text: If a shop listing or an imported box uses one of the leaked names, ask which official colour it is. A seller who uses a name Samsung never sold should be able to say where the phone came from.

sections.title: How to confirm the S26 Ultra colours for your country

blocks.text: Samsung's own buy page for your country is the most reliable list. It shows the colours on sale there and marks which ones are exclusive. Spec pages can list every colour with a general footnote, so use the buy page.

items.title: Open your country's Samsung buy page
items.text: For Vietnam this is [samsung.com/vn's S26 Ultra buy page](https://www.samsung.com/vn/smartphones/galaxy-s26-ultra/buy/). In another country, use that country's Samsung site and open the Galaxy S26 Ultra "Buy" page, not the spec page.

items.title: Read the label next to each colour
items.text: Look for wording like Special Edition, Online Exclusive or "Chỉ có tại Samsung.com". The label also tells you which outlets sell that colour.

items.title: Choose each colour and storage size
items.text: Choose the colour, then each storage size. If a combination shows as unavailable, that colour and size cannot be ordered right now.

items.title: Check the shop you plan to buy from
items.text: If the shop's page lists a colour, that colour is sold there. If the shop shows only four colours, it is not selling Samsung's exclusives.

items.title: Check the phone before paying
items.text: With a used or imported phone, look at the colour and storage yourself before you pay. Compare what the seller says with Samsung's official names in the table above.

blocks.text: If you are buying for someone in another country, check that country's Samsung page as well. Samsung's footnote says colours may vary by country or carrier, and the outlets selling the exclusive colours differ too, as the Vietnam and US pages show.

sections.title: What this guide does not cover

items: Prices for each storage size. Seller prices change often, and FPT Shop's page gave two different figures on the day we checked. For where to buy a phone and what to check, see [buying a phone in Vietnam](/guides/buy-phone-in-vietnam).
Galaxy S26 and S26+ colours in detail. Samsung says the series shares the same colour options, but this page checked only the Ultra's buy and seller pages.
Phone plans and SIMs. For mobile numbers, SIMs and eSIMs, see the [eSIM and SIM guide for Vietnam](/esim-vietnam-guide).
Warranty on phones bought abroad or in exclusive colours. Ask Samsung Vietnam's customer service; we could not confirm the rules.

faqs.q: What colours does the S26 Ultra come in?
faqs.a: The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra comes in six colours. Cobalt Violet, Sky Blue, Black and White are the standard colours, and Pink Gold and Silver Shadow are Samsung.com exclusives. This is according to Samsung's newsroom on 27 February 2026 and Samsung's buy pages checked on 24 November 2026. Samsung says colour availability may vary by country or carrier.

faqs.q: What are the S26 Ultra exclusive colours?
faqs.a: The Galaxy S26 Ultra's exclusive colours are Pink Gold and Silver Shadow, sold only through Samsung's own channels. On 24 November 2026, Samsung Vietnam listed them as Special Editions sold only at Samsung.com, Samsung West Lake and Samsung 68. Samsung US said they are available only at Samsung.com and Samsung Experience Stores. Other shops, such as FPT Shop in Vietnam, list only the four standard colours.

faqs.q: Can I buy the S26 Ultra in Pink Gold in Vietnam?
faqs.a: Yes. In Vietnam the Galaxy S26 Ultra in Pink Gold, called Vàng Hồng on Samsung's site, is sold through Samsung's own channels. On 24 November 2026, Samsung Vietnam's buy page said Vàng Hồng and Bạc Shadow are available only at Samsung.com, Samsung West Lake and Samsung 68. FPT Shop's S26 Ultra page listed only the four standard colours on the same day.

faqs.q: Is Ultraviolet an official S26 Ultra colour?
faqs.a: No. Ultraviolet is not an official Galaxy S26 Ultra colour. It was a name from leaks reported in January 2026, together with Black Shadow, White Shadow and Galactical Blue. Samsung launched the purple Galaxy S26 Ultra as Cobalt Violet, called Tím Cobalt in Vietnam. Treat any listing that uses the leaked names with caution and ask the seller which official colour it is.

faqs.q: Do the Galaxy S26 and S26 Ultra have the same colours?
faqs.a: Yes, according to Samsung's UK newsroom on 27 February 2026. The Galaxy S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra share a unified design and the same colour options: Cobalt Violet, White, Black and Sky Blue, plus Pink Gold and Silver Shadow as Samsung.com exclusives. Samsung Singapore's spec page lists the same six colours with a note that availability may vary by country or carrier.

faqs.q: What are the S26 Ultra colours called in Vietnamese?
faqs.a: On Samsung Vietnam's buy page, checked on 24 November 2026, the Galaxy S26 Ultra colours are Tím Cobalt (Cobalt Violet), Xanh Sky Blue (Sky Blue), Đen Classic (Black) and Trắng Classic (White). The two Special Edition colours are Vàng Hồng (Pink Gold) and Bạc Shadow (Silver Shadow). Vietnamese retailers such as FPT Shop use the same names for the four standard colours.

faqs.q: When did the Galaxy S26 Ultra go on sale?
faqs.a: The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra went on sale on 11 March 2026, according to Samsung's UK newsroom. Samsung announced it at Galaxy Unpacked in San Francisco on 25 February 2026, and pre-orders opened that day. Samsung Vietnam's newsroom also gives 11 March as the start of sales through carriers, retailers and Samsung.com.
